end.summary:
Discussed plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Used examples including deer eating leaves and tiger eating deer.
Built and read food chains with arrows: grass → deer, mango leaf → caterpillar, and algae → larvae → fish.
Explained that arrows point from food to the eater; food-chain teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Manav practised identifying what animals eat and building food chains. They correctly used the food-to-eater arrow in several examples, such as mango leaf → caterpillar and algae → larvae → fish. They were unsure about what earthworms eat, and this was not revisited before the lesson ended. At home, ask them to make two short food chains and explain what each arrow means.
